description: This Java class 'ReadingGoalCalculator' provides static methods for calculating and tracking a user's reading goals, including progress, schedule adherence, and books/pages read within a year.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculator
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to calculate reading progress, schedule adherence, and related metrics for a book tracking application.

methods.name: shouldHaveRead
methods.description: Calculates the number of books that should have been read by this point in the year to stay on target for the goal.

methods.name: booksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Calculates the average number of books to read per week from the start of the year.

methods.name: howManyReadThisYear
methods.description: Counts the number of books or pages read this year based on the goal type and shelf.

methods.name: bookHasFinishDateInThisYear
methods.description: Checks if a book has a finish date within the current year.

methods.name: howFarAheadOrBehindSchedule
methods.description: Calculates the absolute difference between the expected and actual number of books read by this point in the year.

methods.name: calculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Calculates the user's progress towards their reading goal as a fraction.

methods.name: behindOrAheadSchedule
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the user is ahead or behind schedule based on books read.
